introduction.en: Industrial classification is a systematic categorization of manufacturing units based on various parameters like raw material, ownership, and size. It is essential for effective economic planning and targeted policy support.
introduction.hi: Industrial classification is a systematic categorization of manufacturing units based on various parameters like raw material, ownership, and size. It is essential for effective economic planning and targeted policy support.

body.en: Classification helps in identifying the strengths and weaknesses of different sectors. For instance, classifying industries as agro-based or mineral-based helps in resource allocation. Ownership-based classification (Public, Private, Joint, Cooperative) defines the role of the state versus the market. Size-based classification (MSME vs Large) is crucial for providing credit and subsidies to smaller players, ensuring inclusive growth.

conclusion.en: A robust classification framework is vital for India to transition into a global manufacturing hub, especially by adapting to modern technological advancements.
